channel.title: AIBuilder Marketplace — new honest reviews
channel.description: Hand-researched, honest software reviews: real pricing, the honest knock, who should skip it. No hype, no invented numbers.

item.title: Bold Custom Pricing Review (2026): Wholesale Without Plus, From $29/mo
item.description: Bold Custom Pricing: Three plans, each with a 14-day free trial. Bold Custom Pricing has no free plan and charges by customer group.

item.title: Bold Upsell Review (2026): Priced by Your Shopify Plan, Not Your Sales
item.description: Bold Upsell: Shopify Basic is $4.99 a month, Shopify Grow $24.99, Shopify Advanced $74.99 and Shopify Plus $399.99. We have not run the app ourselves.

item.title: bOnline Review (2026): UK Business VoIP From £7 a User
item.description: bOnline: AI For Business Calls is £19.95, shown against a struck-through £21.95. BOnline does not put its contract length on the pricing page.

item.title: Database Mart Review (2026): Cheap Dallas Servers, Older Xeons
item.description: Database Mart: Windows VPS, which includes the Microsoft licence, runs from $5.99 to $63.99. Database Mart is cheap partly because the hardware is older.

item.title: Zoviz Review (2026): Free to Design, Paid to Download
item.description: Zoviz: Three plans, monthly or yearly, with yearly marked -43%. Zoviz lets you design for free and charges when you download.

item.title: Bold Memberships Review (2026): $0.13 per Member a Month
item.description: Bold Memberships: The first 10 members are free forever, the first 30 days are free. Bold Memberships charges for every member, every month.

item.title: Bold Subscriptions Review (2026): $24.99/mo Plus a 2% Fee
item.description: Bold Subscriptions: Grow is $49.99 a month plus 1%, and Scale is $74.99 a month plus 0.9%. Bold Subscriptions never stops charging a percentage.

item.title: Krystal Review (2026): Hosting From £7/mo + VAT, No Teaser Rate
item.description: Krystal — All prices below are in pounds and exclude VAT: the site's Include VAT switch is off by default. Krystal does not win on sticker price.

item.title: Essent Preorder Back in Stock Review (2026): 25 Free, Then $4.95
item.description: Essent Preorder Back in Stock: $0.25 per extra pre-order on Lite, $0.20 on Starter and $0.10 on Essentials. The plans are cheap until a launch works.

item.title: Harbor Compliance Review (2026): $99 Agent, $159 From Year Two
item.description: Harbor Compliance: Registered agent is $99 for the first year for new customers and renews at $159 a year. The $99 on every page is a first-year price.

item.title: DigitalOcean Review (2026): The $4 Server Is Just the Start
item.description: DigitalOcean: App Platform has a free tier for three static-site apps (1 GiB of transfer each, further static apps $3 each).

item.title: Create Review (2026): The Shop Tools Sit on the Top Plan
item.description: Create: Portfolio is €9.99 a month, or €8.33 a month billed yearly, for a 10-page site with 3GB of storage, SSL and a blog.

item.title: Koala Gifts Review (2026): Your Shopify Plan Sets the Price
item.description: Koala Gifts: Basic is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year, Shopify $29.99 or $287.88, Advanced $49.99 or $479.88. The fee does not move by itself.

item.title: Essential Upsell & Cross Sell Review (2026): Priced by Revenue
item.description: Essential Upsell & Cross Sell: Starter is $9.99 a month for up to $500. The plans are metered on revenue the app says it generated.

item.title: Brandye Review (2026): The Free Plan Is a Lifetime Allowance
item.description: Brandye: Every plan includes the product quiz, the AI shopping assistant and AI product questions. Read the free plan as a trial, not a tier.

item.title: Seele Review (2026): Read the Terms Before the Pricing Page
item.description: Seele: Standard is $20 a month for 2,000 Koins, Pro $50 for 6,000 and Ultra $200 for 25,000. You cannot know in advance what a game will cost.

item.title: Jane Review (2026): Priced Per Practitioner, With No Free Trial
item.description: Jane: Extra practitioners cost $40 full-time or $20 part-time. Work out your price from your practitioner count, not from the plan headline.

item.title: StoreLock Review (2026): The Takedowns Matter More Than the Lock
item.description: StoreLock: Image Monitoring is billed on top at $0.20 per image scan. Be clear about which half of the app you are paying for.

item.title: SalesTarget.ai Review (2026): What 2,000 Credits Actually Buy
item.description: SalesTarget.ai: Yearly $1,926, $3,636 and $7,740. The credit numbers on the plan cards shrink once you read the help centre's price list.

item.title: Essential Trust Badges Review (2026): The Cart Badge Is Paid
item.description: Essential Trust Badges: Essential is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year for up to 50,000 views. The free plan is generous on views and tight on badges.

item.title: Koala Bundles Review (2026): The Cap Counts the Whole Bundle
item.description: Koala Bundles: Scale Koala is $19.99 a month or $191.88 a year for up to $5,000. The meter is revenue, and it counts more of it than you might expect.

item.title: Mera Work Review (2026): $3 a User, 90 Days of Data
item.description: Mera Work: In US dollars it is $4 per user a month billed monthly or $3 per user a month billed annually. The price is low and the feature list is long.

item.title: Essential Announcement Bar Review (2026): The Marquee Is Paid
item.description: Essential Announcement Bar: Essential is $9.99 a month or $95.88 a year for up to 50,000 views. The bar the listing leads with is not on the free plan.

item.title: Essential Free Shipping Bar Review (2026): The Cart Bar Is Paid
item.description: Essential Free Shipping Bar: Four plans priced on monthly booster views. Cart-page boosters start on Essential at $14.99 a month.

item.title: GCheck Review (2026): Per-Check Pricing, Sales-Led Sign-Up
item.description: GCheck: Basic is $19.95 per check and covers an SSN trace and address history. The pricing page reads like self-serve and is not.

item.title: Essential Countdown Timer Bar Review (2026): Mind the View Cap
item.description: Essential Countdown Timer Bar: Four plans priced on monthly timer views. The free plan is smaller than it looks, because of what counts as a view.

item.title: FBtrack Review (2026): Multi-Pixel Tracking, Thin Track Record
item.description: FBtrack: Basic is $10 a month for one active pixel, Standard is $15 a month for five active pixels. A pixel app earns its fee by being dull.

item.title: Pickeasy Review (2026): Slots From $9.99, Rates Need Shopify
item.description: Pickeasy: $215.99 for Smart, $323.99 for Premium and $647.99 for Custom. The rate features depend on something Pickeasy does not sell.

item.title: Track123 Review (2026): $9 for 300 Orders, Then 5 Cents Each
item.description: Track123: Three published plans plus Enterprise, priced on synced orders a month. The overage is the most expensive order on the ladder.

item.title: Lovable Review (2026): Hands-On Against Replit and Emergent
item.description: Lovable — Free: 5 build credits a day, capped at 30 a month, which do not roll over. You do not know what a change costs until it is done.
